Ravi: Customer (NorthCrest Financial) asked for our SOC 2 report to clear procurement. Wants a short redacted snapshot to their security reviewers today.
Olivia: We can provide a redacted PDF behind view-only access. Requirements: signed NDA (pdf), list of reviewers (names + corporate emails), and retention window (we suggest 72h).
Mei: Security: redact customer identifiers and any sensitive evidence. Limit to 3 reviewers. Watermark with reviewer name and TTL. No downloads allowed; use secure-docs viewer.
Ravi: They prefer we use their NDA. Is that ok?
legal-bot: Send their NDA to legal for review. If it's standard, turnaround ~24h. If they sign our Mutual NDA instead, we can proceed faster. Include "review copies only" clause.
Olivia: Ops: once NDA + reviewers arrive, I'll stage the file and generate ephemeral link (TTL 72h). We'll stamp PDF and log audit entries.
Mei: Note: if they need more than the snapshot (e.g., bridge-letter), escalate to Compliance — that takes ~5 business days.
Ravi: Got it. I'll ask for the signed NDA and reviewer emails now and post here when they arrive.
Olivia: Thanks — pls cc legal when you upload.
